name: Willem
summary: Outside Northshire Abbey, Willem sends recruits to face the threats gathering in the valley. He serves under Marshal McBride as the Defias Brotherhood presses into Northshire.

sections.title: A Watchman at the Abbey
sections.body:
Deputy Willem watches the gates of Northshire Abbey, where the Stormwind Army holds a foothold in the valley. The kingdom's soldiers are spread across many territories, so small groups like Marshal McBride's garrison must defend the land nearby.

Willem greets incoming volunteers and sends them to aid residents and guard the valley's edges.

sections.title: Confronting the Defias
sections.body:
The Defias Brotherhood is Willem's most pressing concern. Bandits in red bandanas have entered Northshire, stolen supplies, threatened farmer Milly Osworth, and taken footholds among nearby vineyards and hills.

Willem offers bounties on known cutthroats such as Garrick Padfoot. He hopes to break their leadership before they can take the abbey grounds.

faq.answer: Deputy Willem serves in the Stormwind Army outside Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. Under Marshal McBride, he directs recruits against threats in the valley.

faq.q: Who does Deputy Willem report to?
faq.answer: Deputy Willem reports to Marshal McBride, who commands Northshire Valley's defense and military operations.

faq.q: Why is Willem issuing bounties on the Defias?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood has entered Northshire Valley, threatening the abbey and terrorizing local laborers. Willem sends fighters after bandits and leaders such as Garrick Padfoot to restore order.

faq.q: Where can Deputy Willem be found?
faq.answer: Willem waits outside the main entrance of Northshire Abbey in northern Elwynn Forest. There he greets travelers and recruits entering the courtyard.

faq.q: How does Willem assist the local workers?
faq.answer: Willem sends fighters to aid residents whose livelihoods are threatened, including orchardist Milly Osworth and peltskinner Eagan.

faq.q: Why are troops like Willem struggling to maintain order alone?
faq.answer: Stormwind faces internal strain, political tension, and distant military commitments. With King Varian missing, garrisons like Northshire must rely on untested recruits and volunteers to handle unrest at home.

angles.text: As a human stepping out of Northshire Abbey, you may meet Deputy Willem, one of the first Stormwind officers to welcome you into the kingdom's service.
As an Alliance member, you can see through Willem how the Defias unrest reaches even Elwynn's peaceful heartland.
As a warrior, you can serve under Willem's direction, driving out bandits and restoring order to the realm.
